I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Content:** the "Team" heading, the "Invite Member" primary button, and the five members with their emails. Each member has a role select (Admin, Editor or Viewer) set to the role you gave.
- **Heading:** it is written "Team" in the HTML and shown in capitals through CSS, as DESIGN.md requires.
- **DESIGN.md rules:** I followed the screen rules for page layout, the primary button, form fields and list rows. Colours, spacing, radii and type sizes come from `tokens.css`, which I copied into the file's `<style>` (light theme only, just the tokens used).
- **Header row:** I added a small header row ("Name", "Email", "Role") because DESIGN.md asks for one on lists. If you want only your exact content, remove it.
- **Fonts:** with no font files in the folder, Unbounded and Archivo fall back to the system font.
- **Not in the file:** no top navigation bar, since you didn't ask for one.
